articles.title: War is coming ...
articles.description: Tehran sent a message this week to the Lebanese terror proxy Hezbollah: “We estimate that an American attack is a matter of time. You should be prepared.”

articles.title: Smotrich says Israel should annex parts of Lebanon
articles.description: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich called for Israel to annex Lebanon up to current Israeli troop positions. Smotrich stated annexation should extend to Beirut if Hezbollah launches further attacks. A subsequent Hezbollah attack would, per Smotrich, warrant annexation beyond Beirut. The remarks represent a conditional, escalatory territorial position from a senior Israeli cabinet minister.

articles.title: Lebanon uncovers new tunnel amid tensions with Hezbollah: What to know
articles.description: A tunnel was discovered near Beirut as tensions between Lebanese authorities and Hezbollah have been running high over the seizure of weapons shipments destined for the Iran-backed group.
